variant_semantics.R: rated: network copies carry rated capacity, and every capacity-derived Var bound is reset to it (spec section 3 item 3, section 12 ruling 4); the section 3 lower-bound construction
variant_semantics.A: available: network copies keep the certified available capacity and its bounds; an ATTRIBUTION DIAGNOSTIC, NOT a lower bound of production (spec section 11 D-1). The Pyomo objective name d0_lb_objective is the builder's export convention and does not make A a bound.
variant_semantics.C: calendar-only: network copies carry E_C = E_rated * phi_cal^age_end (S rated) and every capacity-derived Var bound is reset to it; ESSO available rows es_e_available == phi^age_end * es_e_rated (spec section 11 D-2, section 12 ruling 3); the Phase-2 object

convention: gross_operational_cost (settlement-EXCLUDED, salvage NOT subtracted): per block w_b * [objective_function_rule(b) - contracted settlement_b - voltage pin_b]; the ESSO contributes 0. Q_cert+ = gross with every detector (slack-penalty) term at max(slack, 0) (spec section 12 ruling 5).
